title: Reconcile European graphics pointer groups
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static census
changes: Reconcile 20 retained European five-slot graphics pointer groups against the current E298 manifest to select whole-bank extraction work.
validation: Protected unit gkitv981 validates all 100 pointer values: all 20 tables and 95 target starts have owners, while the five 71e6f8 starts do not.
limitations: An owned target start does not prove complete payload ownership, and candidate literals do not prove live control flow. Full bank extents, other groups and platform work remain open; no performance comparison was made.
